newsitem.title: INDIA: India says to fully redeem India Development Bonds.
newsitem.headline: India says to fully redeem India Development Bonds.

text.p: Indian Finance Minister P. Chidambaram said on Friday the government would fully redeem India Development Bonds (IDBs) issued in 1991/92 (April-March) in the current 1996/96 fiscal year.

"We have decided to redeem in full the IDBs. This is a sign of our confidence that we can maintain our foreign exchange reserves," he told parliament in reply to a debate on the federal budget for the current fiscal year.
"We do not need to roll over (the bonds)," he said.
He said India needed $2.2 billion this year to redeem the bonds it issued in 1991/92 during a balance of payments crisis, when India faced a foreign exchange shortage.
